name: AgendaClo
description: Per-project task/todo lists for OpenClaw (project = agent), with a Telegram Mini App board.

storePath.description: Where tasks.json lives. Defaults to the plugin state dir.

webProject.description: Which project (agent id) the Mini App manages. Default: main.

ownerIds.description: Telegram user ids allowed to use the Mini App. Empty = any valid Telegram user of this bot.
